newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Mashinoimport signs up one mln bls Iraq oil.
newsitem.headline: Russia Mashinoimport signs up one mln bls Iraq oil.

text.p: Russian oil trading firm Mashinoimport has signed up for one million barrels of Iraqi oil under the second United Nations oil-for-food programme, a senior Russian oil industry source said on Tuesday.
The deal takes Russian firms' total liftings to around 31.3 million barrels, and more deals look set to follow.
"Mashinoimport signed a contract for one million barrels of Basrah Light crude," said Yuri Agababov, deputy director of Zarubezhneft, the Moscow-based company coordinating Russian purchases.
He would not confirm the overall Russian total to date, but said earlier this week that Russian firms, before the Mashinoimport deal, had signed up for 30.3 million barrels.
The Mashinoimport contract means all eight Russian firms taking part in the first U.N. oil-for-food programme have taken part in the second.
Mashinoimport had a contract to lift around three million barrels of Basrah Light under the first 180-day programme.

Two more Russian oil companies -- producers ONAKO and SIDANKO -- are also lining up to buy this time around. A SIDANKO source said a delegation from his company was due to return to Moscow from Baghdad on Wednesday.
"I cannot comment on these two companies at the moment, as I do not have exact information," Agababov said.
Russian contracts are already up on the first oil-for-food deal total of 28.54 million barrels, which represented 23 percent of total liftings.
